scenes.say: Do headlights at night look like big shining stars through your glasses? Let us bust some anti-glare myths.
Myth. Anti-glare is only for computer users.

scenes.en: Plain lenses bounce light off both surfaces. The coating cuts those reflections.
scenes.say: The truth is, plain lenses bounce light off their front and back surfaces. That causes halos at night and reflections on screens. An anti-glare coating cuts those reflections, so more light reaches your eyes.
Myth. It is just a coloured tint.

scenes.en: It is a clear, thin multi-layer coating. People see your eyes, not reflections.
scenes.say: The truth is, it is a clear, very thin, multi-layer coating. In photos and video calls, people see your eyes, not white reflections.

scenes.en: Rinse, then wipe with a microfibre cloth. No hot water, no saree edge.
scenes.say: Care tip. Rinse with water, then wipe with a microfibre cloth. No hot water, and no saree or shirt edge.

scenes.say: At LenzKare, get buy one, get one free on spectacles with Fusion lenses, plus a one-year coating warranty. Visit our store for a free eye test.
